<section
	id="chapter-images"
	class="w-full flex-1 flex flex-col pb-4 cursor-pointer"
	style="gap: var(--strip-gap, 0px)"
	x-data="{
		scrollDown() { window.scrollBy({ top: window.innerHeight * 0.75, behavior: 'smooth' }); },
		scrollUp() { window.scrollBy({ top: -window.innerHeight * 0.75, behavior: 'smooth' }); },
		handleClick(e) {
			const clickX = e.clientX;
			const sectionWidth = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect().width;
			const isLeftHalf = clickX < sectionWidth / 2;

			if (isLeftHalf) {
				this.scrollUp();
			} else {
				this.scrollDown();
			}
		},
	}"
	hx-get="https://site.com/chapters/01J76XZ09NWPN7PMB237QVJYP2/images"
	hx-trigger="change from:[name='reading_style']"
	hx-include="[name='reading_style'],[name='current_page']"
	hx-swap="outerHTML"
	@click="handleClick">

	<img
		src="https://site.us/manga/example_manga/0005-001.png"
		class="max-w-full h-auto mx-auto"
		style="min-height: 50vh"
		alt="Page 1"
		decoding="async"
		loading="lazy"
		onload="this.style.minHeight=''"
		onerror="this.onerror=null; this.style.minHeight=''; this.src='/static/images/broken_image.jpg'" />

	<img
		src="https://site.us/manga/example_manga/0005-002.png"
		class="max-w-full h-auto mx-auto"
		style="min-height: 50vh"
		alt="Page 2"
		decoding="async"
		loading="lazy"
		onload="this.style.minHeight=''"
		onerror="this.onerror=null; this.style.minHeight=''; this.src='/static/images/broken_image.jpg'" />

	<img
		src="https://site.us/manga/example_manga/0005-003.png"
		class="max-w-full h-auto mx-auto"
		style="min-height: 50vh"
		alt="Page 3"
		decoding="async"
		loading="lazy"
		onload="this.style.minHeight=''"
		onerror="this.onerror=null; this.style.minHeight=''; this.src='/static/images/broken_image.jpg'" />

</section>
